speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza
text: asked the Minister for Manpower how successful has the Foreign Workers Ambassador programme been in increasing the well-being of foreign workers.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: We are encouraged that more foreign workers have come forward to volunteer to be trained as Ambassadors.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Many of our Foreign Worker Ambassadors have said that they wish to "pay it forward", having received help from MOM and other Ambassadors previously.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Many of them have also expressed an interest to help their fellow countrymen after settling in Singapore.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Having been briefed by MOM on employment rights and regulations, work safety practices and social norms, the Ambassadors act on their own initiative to reach out to fellow foreign workers.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: (b) Mr Sulthan Kabeer Sahib Bava Bahrudeen, or Bava, together with fellow Ambassadors from the same dormitory, has been going around from one dormitory room to another on weekends to raise awareness amongst foreign workers on a variety of issues.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: These range from employment-related matters to the prevention of dengue, adherence to traffic rules and how to save water.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: We were heartened to know that these two individuals signed up as Foreign Worker Ambassadors thereafter.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: To further his outreach, Raj started taking Mandarin classes in 2017 to connect with Chinese workers, too.
